candidate.definition_en: To come from different directions and meet at one point, or to gradually become similar.
candidate.explanation_ar: يعني يتجمعوا أو يتقابلوا في نقطة واحدة.. زي ما الطرق بتتلاقى في ميدان، أو تتقارب الأفكار والسياسات

senses.definition_en: To move toward and meet at a particular point from different directions.
senses.definition_ar: يتحرك من اتجاهات مختلفة ليلتقي في نقطة واحدة
examples: The two paths converge at the river.
The lines of perspective converge at the vanishing point.

senses.definition_en: To gradually become similar or move toward the same result, opinion, or standard.
senses.definition_ar: يتقارب تدريجياً في الأفكار أو السياسات أو المعايير
examples: Economic policies across Europe are beginning to converge.
The two paths converge at the river.
Economic policies across Europe are beginning to converge.
The lines of perspective converge at the vanishing point.
candidate.mnemonic: عكس 'Diverge'.. افتكر 'Conversation' الناس بتتجمع 'Converge' عشان تتكلم
